benchmark.method: alternating synchronized end-to-end backend.forward wall time over the sealed standard layers and multiple prompt-length buckets; includes tokenization, capture/intervention, device evaluation, and NumPy transfer

speed_gate.criterion: Across the predefined layer-by-length matrix, MLX aggregate median end-to-end latency is at least 5% lower than Transformers/MPS

decision: Use MLX for the pinned GPT-2 FP32 resid_post standard cell only
